provenance: Equivalent publication config assembled from hard_iit/config.json and trial_*_selection.json; original records in results/evidence/hard_iit/
data: synthetic causal Boolean rules, generated with kev.latent_data.generate_causal_splits; rule family only
load: merge Kev LoRA into the base; discard original pointer head; train last six text blocks and three typed parser heads

losses.gold: answer_ce only; gold initial/operator/gate inputs; no next_state_ce
losses.deep: same as r3_state; independent absolute-step transitions

selection: validation answer accuracy, then answer NLL
locked_test: score only after positive controls and all four learned-input arms selected
